title: Descent of a homotopy and cone preserving complex functor
statement: Let $C,D$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian] and let $F:\mathrm{CoCh}(C)\to\mathrm{CoCh}(D)$ be additive with coherent integer shift comparisons [def-weil-triangulated-category]. Suppose $F$ preserves homotopies, sends every cone triangle isomorphically to the cone triangle of its image map [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and preserves every strict lower bound. Then there exist an additive triangulated functor $G:K(C)\to K(D)$ [lem-trf-additive-homotopy-category-triangulated] and a shift-compatible isomorphism $F\mathbin{\circ}q_D\cong q_C\mathbin{\circ}G$, where the displayed compositions use Lean order. Moreover $G$ preserves the property that the underlying complex is bounded below; this is the strict underlying-complex property, not merely its closure under isomorphisms.

source.place: Tag 014S; explicit quotient descent and bounded-below refinement of step 7 of lem-amb-signed-fibre-triangulated.

proof.text: Lift F⋙q_D through the homotopy relation: preservation of homotopies makes its values equal on related maps. The quotient is full and surjective, so additivity descends. Apply the quotient shift-lift construction and its compatibility isomorphism to descend the coherent shifts.

Every distinguished homotopy-category triangle is isomorphic to the quotient image of a cone triangle. Apply G to that isomorphism and combine the factorization isomorphism with the assumed cone-triangle isomorphism. Its image is distinguished, proving G triangulated.

The quotient lift sends an object q_C(I) to q_D(F(I)) by equality. Represent each bounded-below input by its underlying complex and use the assumed lower-bound preservation. Equality, rather than an arbitrary isomorphism, proves the strict underlying-complex property.

lean.statement: theorem exists_coneFunctor_descent {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] [Abelian C] {D : Type u'} [Category.{v'} D] [Abelian D] (F : CochainComplex C ℤ ⥤ CochainComplex D ℤ) [F.Additive] [F.CommShift ℤ] (hH : ∀ {I J : CochainComplex C ℤ} {f g : I ⟶ J}, Homotopy f g → Nonempty (Homotopy (F.map f) (F.map g))) (hc : ∀ {I J : CochainComplex C ℤ} (f : I ⟶ J), Nonempty (F.mapTriangle.obj (mappingCone.triangle f) ≅ mappingCone.triangle (F.map f))) (hb : ∀ (I : CochainComplex C ℤ) (N : ℤ), I.IsStrictlyGE N → (F.obj I).IsStrictlyGE N) : ∃ (G : HomotopyCategory C (.up ℤ) ⥤ HomotopyCategory D (.up ℤ)) (_addG : G.Additive) (_shiftG : G.CommShift ℤ) (alpha : F ⋙ HomotopyCategory.quotient D (.up ℤ) ≅ HomotopyCategory.quotient C (.up ℤ) ⋙ G), alpha.hom.CommShift ℤ ∧ G.IsTriangulated ∧ (∀ K : HomotopyCategory C (.up ℤ), HomotopyCategory.plus C K → HomotopyCategory.plus D (G.obj K))
